members.member:
Search the set-up localization data for the provided assembly for the given string key and return it. If the key is not present, the fallback is shown. The fallback is also required to create the string files to be localized.
Calling this method should always be the first step in your localization chain.
The string key to be returned. The fallback string, usually your source language.# The localized string, fallback or string key if not found.
